title: Chapter 1028 Friend And Enemy
content:
Chapter 1028 Friend And Enemy

"Modun is dead!"

"Modun is dead!"

Three days after the Battle of Baishan Mountain, the good news was sent to Pingcheng together with Mao Dun's head and body. The 100,000 troops stationed here shouted long live!

The man who killed Mao Dun was the right general of the Xiongnu. Now he has established himself as the new Chanyu. This new Chanyu is very good. Not only did he offer Mao Dun's head, but he also promised to send back the people of the Central Plains who had plundered the grasslands. They asked for forgiveness from the Qin Dynasty and promised that they would withdraw from Beijia and Yunzhong, and escape to Mobei, and would no longer return south. The Xiongnu were afraid that Heifu would kill them all. Now that most of the young Xiongnu had been lost, they were already south of the Yinshan Mountains. Stand firm and resist the attack from the Central Plains.

Faced with the obedience of the right general, Heifu asked Lou Jing, who was in charge of the affairs of the vassal state.

"After the Battle of Baideng, how many kings and generals of the Xiongnu are still alive?"

Lou Jing reported: "Those who are still alive include King Zuo Guli, Zuo Dadu Lieutenant, You Da Danghu, and You Gu Duhou. They were all captured by our army and imprisoned at the foot of Baishan Mountain."

"According to your observation, which two of these four people are more honest."

Lou Jing's business ability is still very strong. He learned the Xiongnu language when he was ordered to live in Daidi a few years ago, and he has found out the families and pasts of these people: "King Guli on the left, Da Danghu on the right and Dang Hu on the right. The generals are the same, they are all descendants of the Twins family, while the left captain is of the Lan family, and the right bone captain is of the Sub family. In terms of respect, naturally it is the latter two..."

Heifu understands:

"Let them go."

"I will let Feng Chang engrave the seal again. I will make the left captain the captain of Guiyi. The western Chanyu, south of the desert, north of Juyan, and west of the Yinshan Mountain, will be under his control. The right captain will be the captain of Guiyi. Commander Xianghua, the eastern Chanyu, the south of the desert, the east of Yinshan Mountain, and the north of the Great Wall shall be under his jurisdiction!"

"As for the bitter cold of Mobei, Da Qin's whip is beyond his reach, so I will leave it to General Right to eat sand!"

Lou Jing flattered him and said, "Xia Gong's clever plan is that if the grasslands are divided, they will be weak, and if they are united, they will be strong. If the three Shan Yus stand side by side, the Huns will split up and fight against each other, while the Central Plains will benefit!"

This was not over yet. Heifu continued to make decisions: "The Donghu tribe who fled to Wuhuan Mountain and Xianbei Mountain will also be canonized together. After the spring, we will send people to explore and search for them."

"There is also the land of Beihai. The countries of Hunyu, Qushe, Dingling, Gekun, and Xinli who were surrendered to the Xiongnu must also find ways to let merchants pass over, and each of them will be granted seals and ribbons and named captains of their respective countries."

Who doesn’t know how to open a map and open a border? Regardless of whether it can be actually controlled, hurry up and confirm the legal principles first, and leave these millions of square kilometers of land “from ancient times” to future generations...

"If the above Shanyus, lords, and captains of the Hu tribe are willing to surrender, they will all become vassal states of the Qin Dynasty. They will send hostages to the court and pay a certain amount of animal skins, wool, cattle, and horses to the Central Plains every year!"

The two Huns nobles who were let go, as well as the Donghu and Dingling tribes who were oppressed by the Huns, would be happy to be able to hug Qin's lap.

The end. Heifu thought for a moment, smiled playfully, and asked Lou Jing:

"Lou Jing, what do you think, let the Xiongnu nobles send their daughters to the court to marry the descendants of the princes as concubines, in order to promote good neighborliness and friendship between Xia and Hu? What do you think of it, called 'harmony'?"

Unexpectedly, in history, Lou Jing, who was the first to give Lao Liu the idea of proposing a marriage, and asked him to accept Maodun as a cheap son-in-law, and held high the banner of "For the sake of peace, there is nothing wrong with your majesty being a chanyu grandpa", now he is very opposed to the marriage. …

He bowed and said: "I think it is inappropriate. The ancients said that marriage between husbands is a step in the hierarchy of misfortunes and blessings. If it benefits the inside, it will lead to blessings, and if it benefits the outside, it will bring disasters. Therefore, kings and nobles can marry people of the same race, but it is not suitable to marry foreigners. "

"In the past spring and autumn, when the Southern Barbarians and the Northern Di invaded, King Xiang of Zhou also relied on the Red Di to attack the Zheng State who disrespected the king's orders and shot an arrow on the king's shoulder."

"Afterwards, King Zhou Xiang was so grateful to the Di people that he actually planned to marry a Di girl as his queen. Fu Chen, the official, advised him not to get close to Rong Di and abandon the clan. King Zhou Xiang refused to listen and took the Di girl as his queen. Unexpectedly, the Di girl His views on etiquette were different from those of Hua, and he was disgusted with the old age of King Xiang, so he openly committed adultery with Wang Zidai, the younger brother of King Xiang of Zhou. King Zhou Xiang was so angry that he deposed Queen Di. Queen Di actually led Di people into Qin with Wang Zidai, and occupied Luoyang. King Zhou Xiang ran away and finally caused a catastrophe..."

Heifu blinked and realized that he really didn't know about this.

"The car in front is overturned, and the car behind is a lesson. How can a wild and untamed she-wolf be allowed to enter the house?"

Not to mention that the Central Plains did not like Hu's ugly appearance, plus the different etiquette and customs of the two parties. Even if they were happy for a while, there would be endless troubles afterwards. This move would definitely not please both sides. At least Lou Jing would never want to do more. The grandson of a Hu girl...

Hei Fu also followed the good example, so the matter was settled.

Outside, Shu Suntong and other scribes who arrived with the subsequent army were in a state of excitement.

They wandered around the Baishan Mountain after the war, repeatedly asking the soldiers as they passed by, and felt that the incident of Mao Dun's conferring the head was worthy of a special book, and they should publicize it in Guandong. The one who was wreaking havoc on the barbarians was not some heroic knight, but Duke Xia, who treated the world equally!

"This was not only a victory for the Qin army over the Xiongnu, but also a complete victory for the Xia over the Hu people."

"In the past, Duke Huan of Qi crossed over to Yan to attack the mountain warriors, broke down the isolated bamboos, and left the branches to save the people of Yan. Five hundred years later, Duke Xia personally conquered Daibei. He defeated Maodun, killed more than 100,000 Hu, and rescued Dai. There are hundreds of thousands of people in the land, so it is said that in five hundred years there will be an uncle!"

Today's overlord is naturally the Black Overlord!

But in the eyes of Confucian scholars, hegemony is still not enough, and it must be further promoted to the kingly way!

It's true that drowsiness came to the pillow. After the world was restored, people from far away came to visit one after another!

The uncles and Sun Tong compared the fact that Heifu was granted the titles of the Three Chanyus of the Xiongnu, Xianbei, Wuhuan, Donghu, and Beihai vassal states with the historical tributes from the vassal states of Tang Yu, Xia Yu, Cheng Tang, and Zhou Gong...

"In the past, Tang Yu worshiped nine sages and placed them on the throne. There was great prosperity in the country, but there were no guests, and the phoenixes were in the suburbs. Now the Duke of Xia is in power, and the same is true. This is a sign of the sage's reign!"

The Confucian scholars felt that things were ready, and they were already gearing up. Taking advantage of the continuous victories in civil and foreign wars, they persuaded Duke Xia to move in...

But one thing became a thorn in the hearts of Conglong's ministers.

The generals and counselors under Heifu did not relax their vigilance due to the destruction of the Huns at this moment. They still felt as if they were facing a formidable enemy. They felt that the war was not over yet and that once the snow stopped, they might have to go north again at any time.

Because although the Qin army was completely victorious in this battle, something unexpected happened.

As the hero of the Northern Expedition and the biggest beneficiary after the war, the princes were the ones who least expected this person to appear. They whispered:

"Why is 'Fusu' here?"

…

"I invited him here."

Heifu revealed the truth to his confidant "Mr. Huangshi". Although he had already announced the "death" of Fusu and said that the actual controller of the Liao soldiers was Liu Ji, this trick could only deceive the common people. , such as Zhang Liang and other talented people, with a clear mind.

"Early when I destroyed Chu and went north, I sent an envoy by sea and sent a letter to Fusu, asking him to come to Daibei to hunt wolves together."

"I told Fusu in my letter."

"If you come, we will still be old friends..."

"I still think that this is just a superfluous move that only makes everyone feel uneasy!"

Zhang Liang believes that without Fusu, the Xia army can still defeat Maodun. As for whether he can kill him, it depends purely on luck. But keeping Fusu on the side has created many variables. He feels that Heifu is adding risks to the war. , frowned and said:

"What if he doesn't come, or comes to help the Huns?"

Heifu stroked his two pet dogs and fed them meat of questionable origin while saying:

"That's the enemy!"

Heifu even hummed: "When friends come, there is wine; when enemies come, there are swords and guns..."

He was well prepared for this.

"On the Jiaodong front line, Weiyang and his navy are ready to cross north to Liaodong."

"As for Guangyang County, there is no army going north to attack the Xiongnu. They are still fighting hard. Just wait for the snow to melt before they can cross Luanbu, Yuyang County, which has surrendered to me, and march towards western Liaoning!"

"Fortunately, he is still the Fusu I know."

Heifu stood up: "Get ready, I want to invite Fusu to come to the banquet."

"It's time to settle the grievances between the two of us!"

Zhang Liang said: "If he comes, what will Duke Xia do with him? Let him hide his identity like a minister? But Fusu is different from me. He is the eldest son of the First Emperor of Qin and the orthodox successor of the Qin Kingdom. How can he do this? Are you willing to be a vassal of Duke Xia?"

"But if it is to kill, Fusu can distinguish right from wrong. Once killed, he will be wiped out along with the tens of thousands of his subordinates..."

In Zhang Liang's view, it might be the best way to follow the previously announced news of Fusu's death and let this person disappear from view.

On this matter, Heifu didn't want others to comment: "I have my own plan, but I can get the best of both worlds."

"What is the solution?" Zhang Liang asked, feeling a little uneasy in his heart.

"Of course..."

Heifu raised his head and said with a calm smile: "Recommend the good and give way to the capable!"
